declares.ZwQueryInformationFile: Retrieves information about a file, of a **FILE_INFORMATION_CLASS**.
declares.ZwQueryInformationProcess: Retrieves information about a process, of a **PROCESSINFOCLASS**.
declares.ZwQueryInformationToken: Retrieves information about an access token, of a **TOKEN_INFORMATION_CLASS**.
declares.ZwQueryObject: Retrieves information about an object, of an **OBJECT_INFORMATION_CLASS**.
declares.ZwQuerySection: Retrieves information about a section object, of a **SECTION_INFORMATION_CLASS**. Not documented by Microsoft.
declares.ZwQuerySystemInformation: Retrieves information about the system, of a **SYSTEM_INFORMATION_CLASS**.
declares.ZwQueryVolumeInformationFile: Retrieves information about the volume of a file, of an **FS_INFORMATION_CLASS**.
declares.ZwSetInformationFile: Changes information about a file, of a **FILE_INFORMATION_CLASS**.
declares.ZwSetInformationToken: Changes information in an access token, of a **TOKEN_INFORMATION_CLASS**.
declares.ZwSetVolumeInformationFile: Changes information about the volume of a file, of an **FS_INFORMATION_CLASS**.

types.CURDIR: A current directory: its DOS path and a handle to it, as **RTL_USER_PROCESS_PARAMETERS** holds it.
types.FILE_ACCESS_INFORMATION: The access rights the file was opened with. Class: **FileAccessInformation**.
types.FILE_ALIGNMENT_INFORMATION: The buffer alignment the device needs. Class: **FileAlignmentInformation**.
types.FILE_ALL_INFORMATION: The basic, standard, internal, EA, access, position, mode, alignment and name information of a file in one structure. Class: **FileAllInformation**.
types.FILE_ALLOCATION_INFORMATION: The file's allocation size, to set. Class: **FileAllocationInformation**.
types.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_TAG_INFORMATION: The file's attributes and its reparse tag. Class: **FileAttributeTagInformation**.
types.FILE_BASIC_INFORMATION: The file's four times and its attributes. Class: **FileBasicInformation**.
types.FILE_BOTH_DIR_INFORMATION: One file of a directory listing: times, sizes, attributes and both the long and the short name. Class: **FileBothDirectoryInformation**.
types.FILE_CASE_SENSITIVE_INFORMATION: Whether a directory's names are case-sensitive. Classes: **FileCaseSensitiveInformation**, **FileCaseSensitiveInformationForceAccessCheck**.
types.FILE_COMPLETION_INFORMATION: The I/O completion port and key to associate with the file handle. Classes: **FileCompletionInformation**, **FileReplaceCompletionInformation**.
types.FILE_COMPRESSION_INFORMATION: The file's compressed size and compression format. Class: **FileCompressionInformation**.
types.FILE_DESIRED_STORAGE_CLASS_INFORMATION: The storage tier the file should be on. Class: **FileDesiredStorageClassInformation**.
types.FILE_DIRECTORY_INFORMATION: One file of a directory listing: times, sizes, attributes and name. Class: **FileDirectoryInformation**.
types.FILE_DISPOSITION_INFO_EX: Whether the file is deleted when its last handle closes, with the `FILE_DISPOSITION_` flags. Class: **FileDispositionInformationEx**.
types.FILE_DISPOSITION_INFORMATION: Whether the file is deleted when its last handle closes. Class: **FileDispositionInformation**.
types.FILE_EA_INFORMATION: The size of the file's extended attributes. Class: **FileEaInformation**.
types.FILE_END_OF_FILE_INFORMATION: The file's end-of-file position, to set. Class: **FileEndOfFileInformation**.
types.FILE_FS_ATTRIBUTE_INFORMATION: The file system's attributes, its maximum name length and its name, such as `NTFS`. Class: **FileFsAttributeInformation**.
types.FILE_FS_CONTROL_INFORMATION: The volume's quota and content-indexing settings. Class: **FileFsControlInformation**.
types.FILE_FS_DATA_COPY_INFORMATION: The number of copies of the volume's data. Class: **FileFsDataCopyInformation**.
types.FILE_FS_DEVICE_INFORMATION: The type and characteristics of the volume's device. Class: **FileFsDeviceInformation**.
types.FILE_FS_DRIVER_PATH_INFORMATION: Whether a driver is in the volume's I/O path. Class: **FileFsDriverPathInformation**.
types.FILE_FS_FULL_SIZE_INFORMATION: The volume's total, caller-available and actual free allocation units, and its sector and unit sizes. Class: **FileFsFullSizeInformation**.
types.FILE_FS_FULL_SIZE_INFORMATION_EX: As **FILE_FS_FULL_SIZE_INFORMATION**, with the space reserved and used by the storage stack. Class: **FileFsFullSizeInformationEx**.
types.FILE_FS_LABEL_INFORMATION: A volume label, to set. Class: **FileFsLabelInformation**.
types.FILE_FS_METADATA_SIZE_INFORMATION: The size of the file system's metadata. Class: **FileFsMetadataSizeInformation**.
types.FILE_FS_SECTOR_SIZE_INFORMATION: The volume's physical and logical sector sizes and alignment. Class: **FileFsSectorSizeInformation**.
types.FILE_FS_SIZE_INFORMATION: The volume's total and free allocation units, and its sector and unit sizes. Class: **FileFsSizeInformation**.
types.FILE_FS_VOLUME_INFORMATION: The volume's creation time, serial number and label. Class: **FileFsVolumeInformation**.
types.FILE_FULL_DIR_INFORMATION: One file of a directory listing, with the size of its extended attributes. Class: **FileFullDirectoryInformation**.
types.FILE_FULL_EA_INFORMATION: One extended attribute: its flags, name and value. Class: **FileFullEaInformation**.
types.FILE_ID_BOTH_DIR_INFORMATION: As **FILE_BOTH_DIR_INFORMATION**, with the file ID. Class: **FileIdBothDirectoryInformation**.
types.FILE_ID_EXTD_BOTH_DIR_INFORMATION: As **FILE_ID_BOTH_DIR_INFORMATION**, with a 128-bit file ID and the reparse tag. Class: **FileIdExtdBothDirectoryInformation**.
types.FILE_ID_EXTD_DIR_INFORMATION: As **FILE_FULL_DIR_INFORMATION**, with a 128-bit file ID and the reparse tag. Class: **FileIdExtdDirectoryInformation**.
types.FILE_ID_FULL_DIR_INFORMATION: As **FILE_FULL_DIR_INFORMATION**, with the file ID. Class: **FileIdFullDirectoryInformation**.
types.FILE_ID_GLOBAL_TX_DIR_INFORMATION: One file of a directory listing, with its transactional visibility. Class: **FileIdGlobalTxDirectoryInformation**.
types.FILE_ID_INFORMATION: The volume serial number and the 128-bit file ID. Class: **FileIdInformation**.
types.FILE_IO_COMPLETION_NOTIFICATION_INFORMAT: The `FILE_SKIP_` flags of the file handle's completion notification. Class: **FileIoCompletionNotificationInformation**.
types.FILE_IO_PRIORITY_HINT_INFORMATION: The default I/O priority of the file handle's requests (**IO_PRIORITY_HINT**). It is 8 bytes, as the Native API's headers declare it, where the WDK's is 4. Class: **FileIoPriorityHintInformation**.
types.FILE_IOSTATUSBLOCK_RANGE_INFORMATION: A range of I/O status blocks, for the user-mode I/O of a completion port. Class: **FileIoStatusBlockRangeInformation**.
types.FILE_IS_REMOTE_DEVICE_INFORMATION: Whether the file is on a remote device. Class: **FileIsRemoteDeviceInformation**.
types.FILE_KNOWN_FOLDER_INFORMATION: The known folder a directory is, such as Desktop or Downloads. Class: **FileKnownFolderInformation**.
types.FILE_LINK_ENTRY_FULL_ID_INFORMATION: One hard link of a file, with the parent directory's 128-bit ID. Class: **FileHardLinkFullIdInformation**.
types.FILE_LINK_ENTRY_INFORMATION: One hard link of a file: its parent directory's ID and its name.
types.FILE_LINK_INFORMATION: A hard link to create to the file: its directory and name. Classes: **FileLinkInformation**, **FileLinkInformationBypassAccessCheck**.
types.FILE_LINKS_INFORMATION: The hard links of a file: the bytes needed, the entries returned and the first **FILE_LINK_ENTRY_INFORMATION**. Class: **FileHardLinkInformation**.
types.FILE_MAILSLOT_QUERY_INFORMATION: A mailslot's quota, message counts and read timeout. Class: **FileMailslotQueryInformation**.
types.FILE_MAILSLOT_SET_INFORMATION: A mailslot's read timeout, to set. Class: **FileMailslotSetInformation**.
types.FILE_MEMORY_PARTITION_INFORMATION: The memory partition of the file's pages. Class: **FileMemoryPartitionInformation**.
types.FILE_MODE_INFORMATION: The mode the file was opened with, such as synchronous or write-through. Class: **FileModeInformation**.
types.FILE_MOVE_CLUSTER_INFORMATION: The clusters of a file to move, and the file to move them to. Class: **FileMoveClusterInformation**.
types.FILE_NAME_INFORMATION: The file's name, at most **MAX_PATH** characters. Classes: **FileNameInformation**, **FileAlternateNameInformation**, **FileShortNameInformation**, **FileNormalizedNameInformation**.
types.FILE_NAMES_INFORMATION: One file of a directory listing: its name only. Class: **FileNamesInformation**.
types.FILE_NETWORK_OPEN_INFORMATION: The file's times, sizes and attributes, as a network open reads them in one request. Class: **FileNetworkOpenInformation**.
types.FILE_NETWORK_PHYSICAL_NAME_INFORMATION: The file's full UNC name on a remote server. Class: **FileNetworkPhysicalNameInformation**.
types.FILE_NUMA_NODE_INFORMATION: The NUMA node of the file's device. Class: **FileNumaNodeInformation**.
types.FILE_OBJECTID_INFORMATION: The file's object ID and its extended information. Class: **FileObjectIdInformation**.
types.FILE_PIPE_INFORMATION: A named pipe's read mode and completion mode. Class: **FilePipeInformation**.
types.FILE_PIPE_LOCAL_INFORMATION: The local end of a named pipe: its type, configuration, instances, quotas and state. Class: **FilePipeLocalInformation**.
types.FILE_PIPE_REMOTE_INFORMATION: The remote end of a named pipe: its collect time and maximum collection count. Class: **FilePipeRemoteInformation**.
types.FILE_POSITION_INFORMATION: The file's current byte offset. Class: **FilePositionInformation**.
types.FILE_PROCESS_IDS_USING_FILE_INFORMATION: The processes that have the file open: their number and the first ID. Class: **FileProcessIdsUsingFileInformation**.
types.FILE_QUOTA_INFORMATION: One user's quota on a volume: its times, use, threshold and limit, and the user's SID. Class: **FileQuotaInformation**.
types.FILE_REMOTE_PROTOCOL_INFORMATION: The protocol and version a remote file is reached with. Class: **FileRemoteProtocolInformation**.
types.FILE_RENAME_INFORMATION: A new name for the file, and whether to replace a file of that name. Classes: **FileRenameInformation**, **FileRenameInformationBypassAccessCheck**.
types.FILE_REPARSE_POINT_INFORMATION: One reparse point of a volume: the file's reference number and its tag. Class: **FileReparsePointInformation**.
types.FILE_SFIO_RESERVE_INFORMATION: The bandwidth reserved for the file's scheduled I/O. Class: **FileSfioReserveInformation**.
types.FILE_SFIO_VOLUME_INFORMATION: The volume's limits for scheduled I/O. Class: **FileSfioVolumeInformation**.
types.FILE_STANDARD_INFORMATION: The file's allocation size, end of file, link count and whether it is being deleted or is a directory. Class: **FileStandardInformation**.
types.FILE_STANDARD_LINK_INFORMATION: The file's link counts and whether it is being deleted or is a directory. Class: **FileStandardLinkInformation**.
types.FILE_STAT_INFORMATION: The file's ID, times, sizes, attributes, reparse tag, link count and access rights. Class: **FileStatInformation**.
types.FILE_STAT_LX_INFORMATION: As **FILE_STAT_INFORMATION**, with the Linux owner, group, mode and device of the Windows Subsystem for Linux. Class: **FileStatLxInformation**.
types.FILE_STREAM_INFORMATION: One stream of a file: its name, size and allocation size. Class: **FileStreamInformation**.
types.FILE_TRACKING_INFORMATION: The destination file and the object information of a link-tracking move: its length and first byte. Class: **FileTrackingInformation**.
types.FILE_VALID_DATA_LENGTH_INFORMATION: The file's valid data length, to set. Class: **FileValidDataLengthInformation**.
types.FILE_VOLUME_NAME_INFORMATION: The name of the device the file's volume is on. Class: **FileVolumeNameInformation**.
types.GENERIC_MAPPING: The specific rights that generic read, write, execute and all stand for, for one type of object.
types.OBJECT_BASIC_INFORMATION: An object's attributes, granted access, handle and pointer counts and the sizes of its name, type and security descriptor. Class: **ObjectBasicInformation**.
types.OBJECT_DIRECTORY_INFORMATION: One entry of an object directory: its name and its type's name.
types.OBJECT_HANDLE_FLAG_INFORMATION: Whether a handle is inherited and protected from being closed. Class: **ObjectHandleFlagInformation**.
types.OBJECT_TYPE_INFORMATION: An object type: its name, object and handle counts, valid access and generic mapping. Class: **ObjectTypeInformation**.
types.PEB_VISTA: The process environment block of Windows Vista and Windows Server 2003.
types.PEB_WIN10_R3: The process environment block of Windows 10 version 1709.
types.PEB_WIN10_R4: The process environment block of Windows 10 version 1803.
types.PEB_WIN10_R5: The process environment block of Windows 10 versions 1809 to 21H2.
types.PEB_WIN10_T2: The process environment block of Windows 10 versions 1511 to 1703.
types.PEB_WIN11: The process environment block of Windows 11, up to version 22H2.
types.PEB_WIN7: The process environment block of Windows 7 and Windows Server 2008.
types.PEB_WIN8: The process environment block of Windows 8, 8.1 and Server 2012, and of Windows 10 version 1507.
types.PEB_XP: The process environment block of Windows XP.
types.PROCESS_BASIC_INFORMATION: A process's exit status, the address of its process environment block, its affinity, priority, ID and parent's ID. Class: **ProcessBasicInformation**.
types.PROCESS_BASIC_INFORMATION32: As **PROCESS_BASIC_INFORMATION**, for a 32-bit process whatever the driver's own build: its addresses and IDs are **Long**.
types.PROCESS_BASIC_INFORMATION64: As **PROCESS_BASIC_INFORMATION**, for a 64-bit process whatever the driver's own build: its addresses and IDs are **LongLong**, and the IDs are **uUniqueProcessId** and **uInheritedFromUniqueProcessId**.
types.RTL_DRIVE_LETTER_CURDIR: The current directory of one drive letter, as **RTL_USER_PROCESS_PARAMETERS** holds 32 of them.
types.RTL_DYNAMIC_TIME_ZONE_INFORMATION: A time zone with its key name and whether dynamic daylight time is off. Class: **SystemDynamicTimeZoneInformation**.
types.RTL_PROCESS_BACKTRACES: The stack traces the system has recorded: the memory they use, their number and the first **RTL_PROCESS_BACKTRACE_INFORMATION**. Class: **SystemStackTraceInformation**.
types.RTL_PROCESS_LOCK_INFORMATION: One resource lock: its address, type, owner and counts.
types.RTL_PROCESS_LOCKS: The system's resource locks: their number and the first **RTL_PROCESS_LOCK_INFORMATION**. Class: **SystemLocksInformation**.
types.RTL_PROCESS_MODULE_INFORMATION: One loaded module: its base, size, flags, load order and path.
types.RTL_PROCESS_MODULES: The loaded kernel modules: their number and the first **RTL_PROCESS_MODULE_INFORMATION**. Class: **SystemModuleInformation**.
types.RTL_TIME_ZONE_INFORMATION: A time zone: its bias, names and the dates of standard and daylight time. Classes: **SystemCurrentTimeZoneInformation**, **SystemTimeZoneInformation**.
types.RTL_USER_PROCESS_PARAMETERS: A process's parameters, as Windows Vista and later lay them out: its current directory, DLL path, image path, command line, environment and window settings.
types.RTL_USER_PROCESS_PARAMETERS_WIN10_19H1: As **RTL_USER_PROCESS_PARAMETERS**, for Windows 10 version 1903 and later.
types.RTL_USER_PROCESS_PARAMETERS_WIN10_20H1: As **RTL_USER_PROCESS_PARAMETERS**, for Windows 10 version 2004 and later.
types.RTL_USER_PROCESS_PARAMETERS_WIN10_R5: As **RTL_USER_PROCESS_PARAMETERS**, for Windows 10 version 1809 and later.
types.RTL_USER_PROCESS_PARAMETERS_WIN11_21H2: As **RTL_USER_PROCESS_PARAMETERS**, for Windows 11 version 21H2 and later.
types.RTL_USER_PROCESS_PARAMETERS_XP: As **RTL_USER_PROCESS_PARAMETERS**, for Windows XP and Server 2003.
types.SECTION_BASIC_INFORMATION: A section's base address, its allocation attributes (**NTSectionFlags**) and its maximum size. Class: **SectionBasicInformation**.
types.SECTION_IMAGE_INFORMATION: The image a section maps: its entry point, stack sizes, subsystem and versions, characteristics, machine, flags (**SectionImageBitfield**), loader flags, file size and checksum. Class: **SectionImageInformation**.
types.SECTION_INTERNAL_IMAGE_INFORMATION: As **SECTION_IMAGE_INFORMATION**, with the image's extended flags, such as export suppression and CET shadow stacks. Class: **SectionInternalImageInformation**.
types.SYSTEM_BASIC_INFORMATION: The page size, physical pages, address range and number of processors. Classes: **SystemBasicInformation**, **SystemEmulationBasicInformation**, **SystemNativeBasicInformation**.
types.SYSTEM_BASIC_PERFORMANCE_INFORMATION: The available, committed and total pages. Class: **SystemBasicPerformanceInformation**.
types.SYSTEM_BOOT_ENVIRONMENT_INFORMATION: The boot identifier, the firmware type and the boot flags. Class: **SystemBootEnvironmentInformation**.
types.SYSTEM_BOOT_GRAPHICS_INFORMATION: The boot graphics frame buffer: its address, size, pixel format and stride. Class: **SystemBootGraphicsInformation**.
types.SYSTEM_BOOT_LOGO_INFORMATION: The boot logo's flags and its position in its bitmap. Class: **SystemBootLogoInformation**.
types.SYSTEM_CALL_COUNT_INFORMATION: How many times each system service has been called. Class: **SystemCallCountInformation**.
types.SYSTEM_CALL_TIME_INFORMATION: The time spent in the system services. It lacks the C structure's array of times, TimeOfCalls.
types.SYSTEM_CODEINTEGRITY_INFORMATION: The code integrity options, such as test signing. Class: **SystemCodeIntegrityInformation**.
types.SYSTEM_CODEINTEGRITYPOLICY_INFORMATION: The code integrity policy's options and its hypervisor-enforced options. Class: **SystemCodeIntegrityPolicyInformation**.
types.SYSTEM_CODEINTEGRITYVERIFICATION_INFORMA: The result of verifying an image's code integrity. Class: **SystemCodeIntegrityVerificationInformation**.
types.SYSTEM_DEVICE_INFORMATION: The number of disks, floppies, CD-ROMs, tapes, serial and parallel ports. Class: **SystemDeviceInformation**.
types.SYSTEM_FILECACHE_INFORMATION: The file cache's current and peak size, faults and working-set limits. Classes: **SystemFileCacheInformation**, **SystemFileCacheInformationEx**, **SystemPagedPoolInformationEx**, **SystemSystemPtesInformationEx**.
types.SYSTEM_HANDLE_INFORMATION: The open handles of every process: their number and the first **SYSTEM_HANDLE_TABLE_ENTRY_INFO**. Class: **SystemHandleInformation**.
types.SYSTEM_HANDLE_TABLE_ENTRY_INFO: One open handle: its process, object type, attributes, value, object address and access.
types.SYSTEM_KERNEL_DEBUGGER_INFORMATION: Whether a kernel debugger is enabled and present. Class: **SystemKernelDebuggerInformation**.
types.SYSTEM_LOOKASIDE_INFORMATION: One system lookaside list: its depth, allocations and frees. Class: **SystemLookasideInformation**.
types.SYSTEM_OBJECT_INFORMATION: One object of a type's object list: its creator, flags, counts and name. Class: **SystemObjectInformation**.
types.SYSTEM_OBJECTTYPE_INFORMATION: One object type of the type list: its counts, access and name. Class: **SystemObjectInformation**.
types.SYSTEM_PAGEFILE_INFORMATION: One page file: its total, used and peak size, and its name. Class: **SystemPageFileInformation**.
types.SYSTEM_PAGEFILE_INFORMATION_EX: As **SYSTEM_PAGEFILE_INFORMATION**, with its minimum and maximum size. Class: **SystemPageFileInformationEx**.
types.SYSTEM_PERFORMANCE_INFORMATION: The system's performance counters: idle time, I/O, paging, pools and context switches. Class: **SystemPerformanceInformation**.
types.SYSTEM_PROCESS_INFORMATION: One process of the process list: its threads, times, name, IDs, handle count and memory counters, followed by its **SYSTEM_THREAD_INFORMATION** entries. Classes: **SystemProcessInformation**, **SystemExtendedProcessInformation**, **SystemFullProcessInformation**.
types.SYSTEM_PROCESSOR_INFORMATION: The processor's architecture, level, revision and features. Classes: **SystemProcessorInformation**, **SystemEmulationProcessorInformation**.
types.SYSTEM_PROCESSOR_PERFORMANCE_INFORMATION: One processor's idle, kernel, user, DPC and interrupt times. Class: **SystemProcessorPerformanceInformation**.
types.SYSTEM_SECUREBOOT_INFORMATION: Whether Secure Boot is enabled and capable. Class: **SystemSecureBootInformation**.
types.SYSTEM_THREAD_INFORMATION: One thread of a **SYSTEM_PROCESS_INFORMATION**: its times, start address, IDs, priority and state.
types.SYSTEM_TIMEOFDAY_INFORMATION: The boot time, the current time, the time zone bias and the boot time bias. Class: **SystemTimeOfDayInformation**.
types.TIME_FIELDS: A time as its year, month, day, hour, minute, second, millisecond and weekday, as the kernel's RtlTimeToTimeFields fills it.
types.TOKEN_ACCESS_INFORMATION: A token's SIDs, privileges, authentication ID, type, mandatory policy, flags and AppContainer number. Class: **TokenAccessInformation**.
types.TOKEN_AUDIT_POLICY: A token's per-user audit policy, of **POLICY_AUDIT_SUBCATEGORY_COUNT** subcategories. Class: **TokenAuditPolicy**.
types.TOKEN_CONTROL: What identifies a token: its ID, authentication ID, modified ID and source.
types.TOKEN_DEFAULT_DACL: The DACL a token applies to the objects its process creates. Class: **TokenDefaultDacl**.
types.TOKEN_ELEVATION: Whether a token is elevated. Class: **TokenElevation**.
types.TOKEN_GROUPS: A token's group SIDs and their attributes. Classes: **TokenGroups**, **TokenRestrictedSids**, **TokenLogonSid**, **TokenCapabilities**, **TokenDeviceGroups**, **TokenRestrictedDeviceGroups**.
types.TOKEN_GROUPS_AND_PRIVILEGES: A token's SIDs, restricted SIDs and privileges, with their counts and lengths. Class: **TokenGroupsAndPrivileges**.
types.TOKEN_LINKED_TOKEN: A handle to the token linked to this one, the elevated or the filtered token. Class: **TokenLinkedToken**.
types.TOKEN_MANDATORY_LABEL: A token's integrity level, as a SID and its attributes. Class: **TokenIntegrityLevel**.
types.TOKEN_MANDATORY_POLICY: A token's mandatory integrity policy (**TOKEN_MANDATORY_POLICY_FLAGS**). Class: **TokenMandatoryPolicy**.
types.TOKEN_ORIGIN: The logon session a token's logon session came from. Class: **TokenOrigin**.
types.TOKEN_OWNER: The SID a token assigns as owner of the objects its process creates. Class: **TokenOwner**.
types.TOKEN_PRIMARY_GROUP: The group SID a token assigns to the objects its process creates. Class: **TokenPrimaryGroup**.
types.TOKEN_SOURCE: The source of a token: an 8-character name and an ID. Class: **TokenSource**.
types.TOKEN_STATISTICS: A token's IDs, expiration, type, impersonation level, memory use and counts. Class: **TokenStatistics**.
types.TOKEN_USER: A token's user, as a SID and its attributes. Class: **TokenUser**.

enums.CheckTokenMembershipExFlags: The flags of **CheckTokenMembershipEx**, a routine the package does not declare: include AppContainer and less-privileged AppContainer tokens.
enums.FILE_INFORMATION_CLASS: The classes of file information that **ZwQueryInformationFile** takes, and the **FltQueryInformationFile** and **FltSetInformationFile** of modFltMgr. The table of structures above names each structure's class.
enums.FILE_LX_FLAGS: The flags of **FILE_STAT_LX_INFORMATION.LxFlags**: which of its Linux fields are set.
enums.FILE_LX_MODE: The Linux file type and permission bits of **FILE_STAT_LX_INFORMATION.LxMode**.
enums.FILE_PIPE_COMPLETION_MODE: A named pipe's completion mode, queue or complete, as **FILE_PIPE_INFORMATION.CompletionMode** holds it.
enums.FILE_PIPE_CONFIG: A named pipe's direction, inbound, outbound or full duplex, as **FILE_PIPE_LOCAL_INFORMATION.NamedPipeConfiguration** holds it.
enums.FILE_PIPE_END: Which end of a named pipe, client or server, as **FILE_PIPE_LOCAL_INFORMATION.NamedPipeEnd** holds it.
enums.FILE_PIPE_READ_MODE: A named pipe's read mode, byte stream or message, as **FILE_PIPE_INFORMATION.ReadMode** holds it.
enums.FILE_PIPE_STATE: A named pipe's state, disconnected, listening, connected or closing, as **FILE_PIPE_LOCAL_INFORMATION.NamedPipeState** holds it.
enums.FILE_PIPE_TYPE: A named pipe's type, byte stream or message, as **FILE_PIPE_LOCAL_INFORMATION.NamedPipeType** holds it.
enums.FILE_TX_DIRINFO_FLAGS: The flags of **FILE_ID_GLOBAL_TX_DIR_INFORMATION.TxInfoFlags**: the file's transactional visibility.
enums.FileSystemFlags: The `FILE_` flags of **FILE_FS_ATTRIBUTE_INFORMATION.FileSystemAttributes**: what the file system supports.
enums.FIRMWARE_TYPE: The firmware a system booted from, BIOS or UEFI, as **SYSTEM_BOOT_ENVIRONMENT_INFORMATION.FirmwareType** holds it.
enums.FS_CONTROL_FLAGS: The quota and content-indexing flags of **FILE_FS_CONTROL_INFORMATION.FileSystemControlFlags**.
enums.FS_INFORMATION_CLASS: The classes of volume information that **ZwQueryVolumeInformationFile** and **ZwSetVolumeInformationFile** take. It has no **FileFsGuidInformation**, 15, whose structure the WDK declares only for versions after Windows 11 version 22H2.
enums.IO_PRIORITY_HINT: The I/O priorities of **FILE_IO_PRIORITY_HINT_INFORMATION.PriorityHint**: very low to critical.
enums.LDR_DATA_TABLE_FLAGS: The flags of a loaded module's loader entry, as **RTL_PROCESS_MODULE_INFORMATION.Flags** holds them.
enums.MANDATORY_LEVEL: The integrity levels: untrusted, low, medium, high, system and protected process.
enums.NT_COMPRESSION_FORMAT: The compression formats and engines, for **FILE_COMPRESSION_INFORMATION.CompressionFormat**, an **Integer**.
enums.NTSectionFlags: The `SEC_` attributes of a section, such as `SEC_COMMIT` and `SEC_IMAGE`, for the *AllocationAttributes* of **ZwCreateSection** (modWDM) and **SECTION_BASIC_INFORMATION.AllocationAttributes**.
enums.OB_OBJECT_FLAGS: The flags of an object, for **SYSTEM_OBJECT_INFORMATION.Flags**, an **Integer**.
enums.OBJECT_INFORMATION_CLASS: The classes of object information **ZwQueryObject** takes.
enums.PROCESSINFOCLASS: The classes of process information **ZwQueryInformationProcess** takes.
enums.SECTION_INFORMATION_CLASS: The classes of section information **ZwQuerySection** takes.
enums.SECTION_INHERIT: Whether child processes get a mapped view of a section, `SECINH_ViewShare` or `SECINH_ViewUnmap`, C's `ViewShare` and `ViewUnmap`, for the *InheritDisposition* of C's `ZwMapViewOfSection`, which the package's **ZwMapViewOfSection** does not have.
enums.SectionImageBitfield: The flags of **SECTION_IMAGE_INFORMATION.ImageFlags**, a **Byte**: whether the image is .NET IL-only or native-ready, relocated, mapped flat or based below 4 GB.
enums.SECTOR_SIZE_FLAGS: The flags of **FILE_FS_SECTOR_SIZE_INFORMATION.Flags**: alignment and trim support.
enums.SYSTEM_CODEINTEGRITY_OPTIONS: The options of **SYSTEM_CODEINTEGRITY_INFORMATION.CodeIntegrityOptions**, such as test signing.
enums.SYSTEM_INFORMATION_CLASS: The classes of system information **ZwQuerySystemInformation** takes.
enums.TOKEN_ELEVATION_TYPE: A token's elevation type: default, full or limited.
enums.TOKEN_INFORMATION_CLASS: The classes of token information **ZwQueryInformationToken** and **ZwSetInformationToken** take.
enums.TOKEN_MANDATORY_POLICY_FLAGS: The flags of **TOKEN_MANDATORY_POLICY.Policy**: no write up, new process minimum.

consts.POLICY_AUDIT_SUBCATEGORY_COUNT: The audit policy subcategories of Windows 10: the length of **TOKEN_AUDIT_POLICY**. It is the value of the Windows SDK of Windows 11 version 22H2 (10.0.22621); the SDK of version 24H2 (10.0.26100) and later has 60, so a driver for those versions declares a **TOKEN_AUDIT_POLICY** of 31 bytes itself.
consts.POLICY_AUDIT_SUBCATEGORY_COUNT_Vista: The audit policy subcategories of Windows Vista.
consts.POLICY_AUDIT_SUBCATEGORY_COUNT_Win8: The audit policy subcategories of Windows 8.
